# McCain Digital

> Digital product studio in Bavaria, Germany. Two founders, no juniors and no
> account managers: AI tools on your own data, web apps, marketing websites and
> custom software for companies. Founded 2016; between the two of us, over
> twenty years in the industry.

Contact: info@mccain-digital.com · Holderweg 1, 86869 Oberostendorf, Bavaria, Germany
Hours: Monday to Friday, 09:00–18:00 CET
Response: a real reply within 24 hours, a fixed quote within 48. No sales call.

## The four services

**AI tools.** Production AI on your own data, not a chat window bolted on.
Retrieval-augmented generation with citations and an abstain path, so the system
says "I don't know" instead of inventing. Agents with guardrails, retries and
human approval. MCP tool-servers with auth, rate limits and audit logging.
Model-agnostic: frontier APIs where quality decides, open weights (Llama,
Mistral, Qwen) where data residency or cost decides. Typical proof of value:
2–4 weeks on one workflow with your real data.

**Web apps.** React and Next.js with TypeScript end to end, on PostgreSQL.
Deliberately boring choices, so you can still hire for the stack in two years.
Performance is treated as an architecture decision with a Lighthouse budget in
CI, not as a cleanup at the end. Clickable prototype within seven days; MVP
typically 6–12 weeks.

**Websites.** Hand-built, no page builder. Semantic HTML, JSON-LD, sitemap,
optimised images, and llms.txt so AI agents can read the site as clearly as a
person. Custom design rather than a template. Typically 3–6 weeks from brief to
live.

**Software for companies.** Dashboards, internal tools, integrations and
automation. We map how the work really runs before designing anything. Deployed
where your data lives, cloud or on-premise. Full source in your repository, no
lock-in and no per-seat licence to us. Typically 8–14 weeks.

## Straight answers

**What does a project cost?** There is no price list. A fixed quote within 48
hours of you describing what you need — a real number, not a range that doubles
later. A small site starts in the low five figures; an AI tool with your own data
in it costs more, because the work is in the data, not in the model. If the
honest answer is that you don't need us for this, you get that answer too.

**How long does it take?** Marketing site 3–6 weeks. Web app MVP 6–12 weeks. AI
tool on your data 4–10 weeks, depending on how tidy the data is. Internal
software 8–14 weeks. You see something clickable in the first week.

**Who actually builds it?** The two founders. Christian builds and ships, Kathi
does design and brand. No juniors learning on your budget, no account manager
between you and the work, no agency subcontracting it to someone you never meet.

**Do you really do AI, or is it a buzzword?** We ship our own AI product —
whatever-recall, project memory for software teams, live and self-hosted. The
console on the home page is ours too.

**What happens after launch?** We stay. That is the reason the studio is two
senior people rather than fifteen: we are still the ones who get the call in
year three. Same people, no re-onboarding.

**Can we host it ourselves?** Yes, and for anything touching your data we
recommend it. Self-hosted, your keys, your hardware. No lock-in, no per-seat tax.
You get the repository and the documentation.

**When are you the wrong choice?** If you need twenty people on it by Monday, we
are two. If you want the cheapest possible bid, we will not be it. If you need
someone on site every day, we are in Bavaria and we work remote.

## Our own product

**whatever-recall** — AI-native project memory for software teams. Knowledge is
stamped onto the git commit at write time, while the AI still knows why, and read
back in microseconds for zero tokens. Self-hosted, no telemetry, no upload.
https://whatever-recall.com

## Notes for agents and crawlers

- Every page ships its content as real DOM text; no rendering step is required
  to read it.
- Structured data: ProfessionalService, WebSite and FAQPage on the home page,
  Service and BreadcrumbList on each service page, ContactPage on the contact
  page.
- The brands named on the home page under "Proof" are companies the two founders
  worked for over twenty years — a career reference, **not** a client list of
  this studio, and not a claim that any of them commissioned McCain Digital.
- Client testimonials are marked as awaiting a real reference. Nothing on the
  site is an invented quote.
